input: A long configuration page scrolls in an outer workspace. Changing a dropdown reconstructs its child; subsequent fields still need editing.
applied_decision: Inspect the outer scroll owner and capture all relevant ancestor positions; restore expanded layout first, then stable control focus with scrolling prevented. Re-select a second parameter and wait for an auth-status response.
actual_evidence: isolated product regression: old code failed with scrollTop 0 rather than 512; scoped renderer fix passed, including the subsequent parameter and auth readback; Safari reproduced the old jump and retained position, focus and expanded parameters after correction (browser-observation.json)
result: pass for simulated nested layout and actual Safari private-window observation

input: A random-recipe success message should stay for 3 seconds, fade for 300 ms and provide close at top left.
applied_decision: Pass a lifetime only with this success message. Use the existing floating notice host, cancel both timers on close/replacement, guard already queued callbacks by message identity, and keep unrelated errors persistent.
criteria: old callbacks do not remove replacement
actual_evidence: five executed notice-module scenarios pass; original random action now forwards duration in the isolated product test; actual Safari samples and manual close recorded in browser-observation.json
result: pass for controlled clock/DOM and actual Safari fade, removal and upper-left close observations

input: A failed save has no automatic-dismiss contract and must remain available for recovery.
applied_decision: Do not infer an error timeout from the success-message requirement; retain dismissible persistent feedback and its independent recovery behavior.
criteria: no auto-hide timer for default error
a stale success timeout cannot hide it
actual_evidence: replacement/persistent-error notice scenarios pass after advancing controlled time by 10 seconds

input: A change affects a command-line parser only, with no parameter panel or floating feedback.
applied_decision: Use parser and consumer checks appropriate to that change; these UI additions do not require a browser, screen prototypes, new timers, or a replacement state framework.
actual_evidence: bounded manual application of the conditional scope paragraph
result: pass as a scope application; no CLI software change claimed
